company: 北京天壇醫院研究者發起（主辦者即主持人：王擁軍／Yilong Wang，中國）
mechanism: 登錄描述為源自幹細胞分泌之外泌體（exosome）的神經修復蛋白，主張具選擇性組裝、標靶遞送與神經保護作用；給藥途徑含鞘內注射與靜脈輸注（依試驗而異）
phase: 早期 Ph1（兩項並行試驗）
status: 兩項試驗同步收案中，登錄均於 2026-09-09 更新：NCT07514923（MSA 小腦型專屬、隨機、鞘內併靜脈給藥、n=20、主要指標純為安全性、主要完成日 2027-01）與NCT07476352（擴充試驗、全體 MSA、開放標示單臂、僅靜脈給藥、n=60、主要指標含安全性與 UMSARS 變化、主要完成日 2027-10）。皆為單一站點（北京天壇醫院）、研究者發起。⚠️ 目前無任何結果公開讀出。
relevance: 外泌體衍生蛋白路線，是本站目前唯一以幹細胞分泌體（secretome）而非細胞本身為藥物實體的 MSA 在研療法
note: → 這條路線與 Mayo、韓國各家的間質幹細胞（MSC）輸注屬同一個「再生／修復」大類，但藥物實體不同：MSC 療法投的是活細胞，本案投的是細胞分泌物的蛋白成分——理論上可迴避活細胞的存活、歸巢與批次一致性問題，也較易標準化與定量。⚠️ 但必須誠實標註本案的證據基礎目前極薄：公開來源未見同儕審查的臨床前資料，亦未見蛋白身分、純化方式或製程說明，機制敘述全數僅出自主辦方自填的登錄文字；兩項試驗皆為單一站點、研究者發起、合計 n=80，且登錄未指明背後是否有商業開發者。擴充試驗雖以 UMSARS 為主要指標之一，然開放標示單臂設計無法與 MSA 的自然病程區辨。本站據公開登錄如實收錄其存在與設計，不就其機制主張或潛在療效作任何背書。

sources.label: 試驗登錄 NCT07476352（擴充試驗）

en.company: Investigator-initiated at Beijing Tiantan Hospital (sponsor-investigator: Yilong Wang, China)
en.mechanism: Registered as a nerve repair protein derived from exosomes secreted by stem cells, claimed to offer selective assembly, targeted delivery and neuroprotection; administered intrathecally and/or intravenously depending on the trial
en.status: Two trials are recruiting concurrently, both with registrations updated 2026-09-09: NCT07514923 (specific to the cerebellar subtype, randomised, intrathecal plus intravenous dosing, n=20, primary outcomes purely safety, primary completion 2027-01) and NCT07476352 (the expansion study, MSA generally, open-label single-arm, intravenous only, n=60, primary outcomes covering safety and change in UMSARS, primary completion 2027-10). Both are single-site studies at Beijing Tiantan Hospital, investigator-initiated. ⚠️ No results have been read out publicly.
en.relevance: An exosome-derived protein approach — currently the only MSA therapy tracked here whose drug substance is the stem cell secretome rather than the cells themselves
en.note: → This sits in the same 'regenerative/repair' family as the mesenchymal stem cell (MSC) infusions from Mayo and the Korean developers, but the drug substance differs: MSC therapies administer living cells, whereas this administers protein components of what those cells secrete — which in principle sidesteps questions of cell survival, homing and batch consistency, and is easier to standardise and quantify. ⚠️ The evidence base here must be described honestly as very thin: no peer-reviewed preclinical data are available publicly, nor any statement of protein identity, purification or manufacturing, and the mechanistic description comes solely from the sponsor's own registry text. Both trials are single-site, investigator-initiated and total n=80, and the registrations name no commercial developer. Although the expansion study lists UMSARS among its primary outcomes, an open-label single-arm design cannot be distinguished from the natural history of MSA. This site records the existence and design of the programme as publicly registered, and endorses neither its mechanistic claims nor any potential efficacy.

company: BioArctic AB（瑞典，Nasdaq Stockholm: BIOA B）
mechanism: 靜脈輸注單株抗體，設計上選擇性結合病理性 α-synuclein 的原纖維／聚集體形式，目標為降低其細胞間擴散
status: Ph2a「EXIST」研究（NCT06671938）於 2026-08-10 完成、登錄 2026-08-21 更新為 Completed。該研究同時納入輕中度帕金森病與 MSA 兩族群，實際收案 38 人（MSA 約 12 人），2:1 隨機、四重盲、多重劑量遞增，站點在波蘭 2 站與西班牙 5 站；主要指標為安全性與耐受性。2025-06 期中安全性審查為安全、耐受良好並啟動第二劑量世代。公司公開表示正籌備 Ph2b。⚠️ 尚無療效或生物標記結果公開讀出。
relevance: α-synuclein 抗體，MSA 為其兩個納入族群之一
note: → 與多數 α-synuclein 抗體一樣，本案的 MSA 族群規模很小（約 12 人）且主要指標是安全性，因此不會、也無意產生療效證據；它的訊息價值在於能否支撐 Ph2b 的劑量與族群選擇。此類抗體在 MSA 面臨的共同問題是病灶位於寡突膠細胞內、細胞外抗體能觸及的比例仍有爭議。

sources.label: Ph2a 擴充納入 MSA 病人（BioArctic）
期中安全性審查後啟動下一世代（2025/06）

en.company: BioArctic AB (Sweden, Nasdaq Stockholm: BIOA B)
en.mechanism: An intravenously infused monoclonal antibody designed to bind selectively to fibrillar/aggregated forms of pathological alpha-synuclein, aiming to reduce cell-to-cell spread
en.status: The Phase 2a 'EXIST' study (NCT06671938) completed on 2026-08-10, with the registration updated to Completed on 2026-08-21. It enrolled both mild-to-moderate Parkinson's disease and MSA cohorts, with an actual enrolment of 38 (about 12 with MSA), randomised 2:1, quadruple-blind and multiple ascending dose, across 2 sites in Poland and 5 in Spain; the primary outcome is safety and tolerability. An interim safety review in June 2025 found the drug safe and well tolerated and the second dose cohorts were opened. The company has said publicly that it is preparing a Phase 2b. ⚠️ No efficacy or biomarker results have been read out publicly.
en.relevance: An alpha-synuclein antibody with MSA as one of its two enrolled populations
en.note: As with most alpha-synuclein antibodies, the MSA cohort here is small (roughly 12 patients) and the primary outcome is safety, so the study will not, and is not designed to, generate efficacy evidence; its informational value lies in whether it supports dose and population selection for a Phase 2b. The shared difficulty for antibodies of this class in MSA is that the pathology sits inside oligodendrocytes, and how much of it an extracellular antibody can reach remains contested.

sources.label: Phase 2a expanded to include MSA patients (BioArctic)
Next cohorts initiated after interim safety review (2025/06)

mechanism: 自體脂肪間質幹細胞（鞘內注射）
status: 進行中（NCT05167721 隨機雙盲對照）
note: → 與 Stemchymal 機制最接近的 MSA 案（脂肪 MSC）。Ph1/2：24 人、10–200M 細胞鞘內；UMSARS 進展較配對對照顯著減緩；惟最高劑量 200M 有腰神經根增厚/疼痛（4 中 3 人），25M 劑量安全性較佳。→ 給仲恩的教訓：劑量與給藥途徑（鞘內 vs 靜脈）攸關安全窗口。

en.note: The closest analog to Stemchymal (adipose MSC) in MSA. Ph1/2: 24 patients, 10–200M cells intrathecal; UMSARS progression markedly slower vs matched controls; but the top 200M dose caused lumbar nerve-root thickening/pain (3 of 4), while 25M was safer. Lesson for Steminent: dose and route (intrathecal vs IV) drive the safety window.

sources.label: Mayo intrathecal autologous MSC trial NCT05167721

Mayo 鞘內自體 MSC 試驗 NCT05167721

mechanism: 自體骨髓間質幹細胞（動脈內＋靜脈）
note: → MSA-C 隨機試驗（33 人，MSC 動脈內＋靜脈 vs 安慰劑）：MSC 組 UMSARS 總分與 Part II 惡化顯著較小（p=0.047、0.008），腦部葡萄糖代謝/灰質密度下降較少；無直接相關嚴重不良事件。是「異體 MSC 治 MSA」概念的早期人體佐證。

en.note: MSA-C randomized trial (33 patients, MSC intra-arterial + IV vs placebo): the MSC group had significantly smaller increases in total and Part II UMSARS (p=0.047, 0.008) and less decline in cerebral glucose metabolism/grey-matter density; no directly-related serious AEs. Early human support for MSC in MSA.
en.mechanism: Autologous bone-marrow mesenchymal stem cells (intra-arterial + IV)

韓國 MSC MSA 隨機試驗 Lee 2012 (PubMed)

mechanism: 小分子（調節鐵/抑制 α-synuclein 聚集）
status: Ph2 正面（2025/01 topline，modified UMSARS-I 顯著改善）；2026/07/07 公布 FDA End-of-Phase-2 會議紀錄，確認註冊路徑——Ph3 約 200 人、1:1 隨機 ATH434 50mg 或安慰劑、每日兩次共 12 個月，主要終點為 11 項 UMSARS Part I；FDA 同意「單一樞紐試驗＋確認性證據」即可支持核准，公司稱 2026 年底前啟動 Ph3 作業。
note: → 目前 MSA 小分子最亮眼者：ATH434-201 於 modified UMSARS Part I 達統計與臨床顯著；獲 FDA Fast Track，且已與 FDA 就樞紐 Ph3 設計與主要終點取得一致。屬 α-synuclein／鐵路線，與細胞治療機制不同。

en.note: The standout MSA small molecule: ATH434-201 hit statistically and clinically significant improvement on modified UMSARS Part I; it holds FDA Fast Track and has now aligned with the FDA on pivotal Ph3 design and primary endpoint. An alpha-synuclein/iron route, distinct from cell therapy.
en.mechanism: Small molecule (iron modulation / inhibits α-synuclein aggregation)
en.status: Positive Ph2 (2025/01 topline: significant improvement on modified UMSARS-I); FDA End-of-Phase-2 meeting minutes announced 2026/07/07 confirmed the registrational pathway — a Ph3 of roughly 200 patients randomised 1:1 to ATH434 50mg or placebo twice daily for 12 months, with the 11-item UMSARS Part I as the primary endpoint. The FDA agreed that a single pivotal trial plus confirmatory evidence could support approval, and the company says Ph3 activities will start by end-2026.

status: AMULET Ph2 顯示疾病修飾潛力；MASCOT Ph3 進行中；FDA Fast Track
note: → 大藥廠押注的 anti-aSyn 抗體，已進 Ph3（MASCOT）。若成功將重塑 MSA 疾病修飾標準，是 MSA 賽道最需盯的資產。

en.note: Big-pharma anti-alpha-synuclein antibody now in Ph3 (MASCOT). If successful it would reset the MSA disease-modifying standard — the key MSA asset to watch.
en.status: AMULET Ph2 suggested disease-modifying potential; MASCOT Ph3 ongoing; FDA Fast Track

mechanism: 反義寡核苷酸 ASO（標的 SNCA/α-synuclein）
note: → HORIZON Ph1 安全可耐受，但 Biogen 於 2025/02 終止 ION464——與其退出 SCA3 ASO 同一模式（大廠反覆退出神經退化 ASO）。反襯細胞治療路線的差異化。

en.note: HORIZON Ph1 was safe/tolerated, but Biogen discontinued ION464 in Feb 2025 — the same pattern as its SCA3 ASO exit. Highlights the differentiation of the cell-therapy route.

mechanism: 髓過氧化物酶 MPO 抑制劑（抗神經發炎）
note: → 抗神經發炎小分子，M-STAR Ph3 於 MSA 未達主要終點。與 Biohaven 的 SCA 對手 troriluzole 同屬「症狀期難達標」教訓。

en.note: An anti-neuroinflammatory small molecule; the M-STAR Ph3 failed its MSA primary endpoint (2021). Another 'hard to hit endpoints in symptomatic disease' lesson, akin to Biohaven's SCA drug troriluzole.

company: 思捷優達 Dasher Neuroscience（台灣）
mechanism: D-胺基酸氧化酶（DAAO）抑制劑（口服，一日兩次）
status: 收案完成、雙盲進行中（登錄狀態查核日 2026-08）
note: → 公司自述為新化學實體（NCE），作用為抑制發炎細胞激素、降低神經發炎並促進神經可塑性。全球多中心、雙盲、安慰劑對照、劑量遞增 Ph2，收案 30 歲以上、依國際運動障礙學會（MDS）診斷準則確診的 MSA 病人，MSA-P 與 MSA-C 兩種次型皆收；主要終點為不良事件發生率與嚴重度（安全性與耐受性），次要終點為藥物動力學參數、UMSARS 與 10 公尺步行測試。站點分布於美國（6 站）、日本（1 站）與台灣（2 站）。⚠️ 收案人數兩個公開來源不一致：公司 2026-07-28 新聞稿稱「已完成 90 人收案」，而 ClinicalTrials.gov 登錄的預計收案數為 75 人——本平台兩者並列，不擇一採信。法規面：公司公開資料載有美國 FDA 快速通道資格（Fast Track），以及美國、日本與歐盟的孤兒藥資格（公開來源未載明各項的核予日期，故不填年份）。公司表示主要數據（topline）預計 2027 年第 1 季公布，登錄的主要完成日為 2027-06-30。（尚未有任何療效數據公開讀出）

en.mechanism: D-amino acid oxidase (DAAO) inhibitor (oral, twice daily)
en.status: Enrolment complete, double-blind phase ongoing (registry status verified 2026-08)
en.note: → Described by the company as a new chemical entity (NCE) that inhibits inflammatory cytokines, reducing neuroinflammation and enhancing neuroplasticity. A global multi-centre, double-blind, placebo-controlled, dose-escalation Ph2 enrolling MSA patients aged 30 and over diagnosed per Movement Disorder Society (MDS) criteria, including both the parkinsonian (MSA-P) and cerebellar (MSA-C) subtypes; the primary endpoint is the incidence and severity of adverse events (safety and tolerability), with pharmacokinetic parameters, UMSARS and the 10-Metre Walk Test as secondary endpoints. Sites are in the United States (6), Japan (1) and Taiwan (2). ⚠️ The two public sources disagree on enrolment: the company's 2026-07-28 press release states 90 patients enrolled, while the ClinicalTrials.gov registration lists a target enrolment of 75 — this platform reports both rather than choosing between them. On the regulatory side, company materials cite US FDA Fast Track designation and orphan drug designation in the United States, Japan and the European Union (the public sources do not give the dates on which these were granted, so no years are stated here). The company expects topline data in Q1 2027; the registered primary completion date is 2027-06-30. (No efficacy data have been read out publicly.)

FDA Fast Track designation announcement (Taiwan Healthcare+)

company: 小野藥品 Ono Pharmaceutical（與 Deciphera）
status: 雙盲核心部分完成，規劃 Ph3
note: → 2025/10 公司公布期中分析見療效訊號；2026/05 於第 7 屆世界帕金森大會（WPC）發表 24 週雙盲核心部分：MSA-P 次族群 mUMSARS 自基線變化 安慰劑 3.90 vs 中劑量 1.39、高劑量 1.16；TEAE 發生率與安慰劑相當（91% vs 93%）；MRI 見劑量依存的腦萎縮抑制傾向。公司表示與 Deciphera 規劃樞紐性 Ph3。（次族群結果、非全體主要終點）

en.status: Double-blind core part complete; Ph3 planned
en.note: Ono reported efficacy signals at an interim analysis in 2025/10, and presented the 24-week double-blind core part at the 7th World Parkinson Congress in 2026/05: in the MSA-P subgroup, change from baseline in mUMSARS was 3.90 on placebo vs 1.39 (medium dose) and 1.16 (high dose); TEAE rates were similar to placebo (91% vs 93%); MRI showed a dose-dependent trend toward suppressed brain atrophy. Ono and Deciphera plan a pivotal Ph3. (Subgroup findings, not an overall primary endpoint.)

mechanism: 標的病理性 α-synuclein 寡聚體（口服）
status: 收案中；另有延伸試驗 NCT07197866
note: → 多中心雙盲隨機安慰劑對照，48 週治療、每人約 56 週；收臨床可能／很可能 MSA 且能獨立行走 10 公尺者；站點含美、以、義、西、德、法、日、塞爾維亞。2025 獲 FDA 快速通道資格。尚無療效讀出。

en.note: Multicentre, double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled: 48 weeks of treatment, ~56 weeks per participant; enrols clinically possible/probable MSA able to walk 10 m unaided; sites in the US, Israel, Italy, Spain, Germany, France, Japan and Serbia. FDA Fast Track granted in 2025. No efficacy readout yet.

mechanism: 全人源 anti-CD3 單株抗體，經鼻黏膜免疫調節、降低微膠細胞活化
relevance: 免疫調節路線（與 MSC 抗神經發炎機制相鄰）
note: → 以 PET 影像測微膠細胞活化為主要評估。2026/05/14 公司公布前 2 名 MSA 受試者的定量 PET：基底核與視丘攝取顯著下降。**僅 2 人、極早期，尚無臨床療效數據。**

en.mechanism: Fully human anti-CD3 monoclonal antibody given nasally; immune modulation reducing microglial activation
en.relevance: Immune-modulation route (adjacent to the anti-neuroinflammatory MSC mechanism)
en.note: Microglial activation on PET is the primary measure. On 2026/05/14 the company reported quantitative PET from its first 2 MSA patients: significantly reduced basal ganglia and thalamic uptake. **Only 2 patients, very early, with no clinical efficacy data yet.**

drug: XS411CN 多巴胺神經前驅細胞
mechanism: 多巴胺神經前驅細胞移植（細胞替代）
note: → 針對帕金森型 MSA（MSA-P）的細胞治療 Ph1，登錄於 ClinicalTrials.gov、預計主要完成 2026/08。與 MSC 的「旁分泌保護」不同，屬**細胞替代**路線。尚無任何臨床數據。

en.mechanism: Dopaminergic neural progenitor cell transplantation (cell replacement)
en.note: A Phase 1 cell therapy in parkinsonian-type MSA (MSA-P), registered on ClinicalTrials.gov with primary completion estimated 2026/08. Unlike the paracrine protection of MSC, this is a **cell replacement** approach. No clinical data yet.

mechanism: 正腎上腺素回收抑制劑（治療神經性姿勢性低血壓 nOH，症狀治療）
note: → 73 名合併姿勢性低血壓的 MSA 病人；**試驗未達主要終點**，惟次要分析顯示隨機到安慰劑者惡化、續用者維持開放標籤期的功能水準，站立血壓於停藥後顯著下降。作者標為 Class III 證據。屬症狀控制，非疾病修飾。

en.mechanism: Norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor for neurogenic orthostatic hypotension (symptomatic)
en.note: 73 MSA patients with orthostatic hypotension; **the trial did not meet its primary endpoints**, but secondary analysis showed patients randomised to placebo worsened while those continuing treatment maintained their open-label level of function, with standing blood pressure falling significantly after withdrawal. The authors rate it Class III evidence. Symptom control, not disease modification.

mechanism: 以 TransportVehicle（TV）平台穿越血腦障壁，直接靶向 α-synuclein 以減少毒性聚集
status: 尚未進入臨床；列於 2025–2027 IND-enabling 名單，最快 2026 進入臨床，目前主打帕金森病
relevance: 機轉相鄰、標的相同但靶細胞不同
note: → 與 MSA 的關聯是機轉相鄰而非直接競爭：MSA 與帕金森同屬 α-synuclein 病變，但 MSA 病灶在寡突膠細胞、帕金森在神經元，靶細胞不同，藥物未必能直接跨過去。真正的看點是 TV 血腦障壁平台——CNS 遞送若被解決，整個「打得到標的但送不進去」的失敗類別會被重新洗牌。

sources.label: Denali 里程碑與優先事項（含 α-synuclein 計畫）

en.mechanism: Crosses the blood-brain barrier on the TransportVehicle (TV) platform, targeting alpha-synuclein directly to reduce toxic aggregates
en.status: Not yet in the clinic; listed among the 2025–2027 IND-enabling programmes and could enter trials as early as 2026, currently aimed at Parkinson's disease
en.relevance: Adjacent mechanism, same target, different target cell
en.note: Its link to MSA is mechanistic adjacency rather than direct competition: MSA and Parkinson's are both synucleinopathies, but MSA pathology sits in oligodendrocytes and Parkinson's in neurons, so a drug does not necessarily carry across. The point of interest is the TV blood-brain-barrier platform — solving CNS delivery would reshuffle the entire failure category of drugs that engage a target but cannot reach it.
